scenes.say: [casual] A typical chart: five regions, five colours. [dry] Where do you look? [beat] [emphatic] Grey everything... except the one bar that matters. [confident] Now it has a point.

scenes.title: APAC grew *4x* faster than any other region
scenes.say: [conversational] The rule is simple. Grey is context. One colour is the point. [pointed] And the title says why it's lit.
